name: fastsnap
summary: Device state in a block: save every non-iterative savevm section into one heap buffer and restore from it, for fast in-process snapshot restore under TCG.
notes: The adopted code is whole files under srcPaths, never interleaved into patch hunks. The series patch is ours: it adds accessors to migration/savevm.c so the adopted code never sees SaveStateEntry's layout, deliberately NOT the struct hoist the upstream project uses.
